source.name: Sports Business Journal – 'Siete Foods seizes Austin FC sleeve space following PepsiCo acquisition'
source.quote: Financial terms of the partnership were not disclosed, but industry sources pegged the value of MLS sleeve sponsorships at $1M-$2M per season.

note: Siete's logo went on the right sleeve from 2025. Terms not disclosed; SBJ reports industry sources peg MLS sleeve deals at $1M-$2M per season (league-wide estimate, not Siete's terms).
